import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, cross_val_score
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer, CountVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB

r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")
y = (r["rating"] <= 3).astype(int)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(r["text"], y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y)


pipes={"words":make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)),"bigrams":make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2)),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)),"chars":make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(analyzer="char_wb",ngram_range=(2,4)),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)),"nb":make_pipeline(CountVectorizer(),MultinomialNB())}
cv_f1={k:round(float(cross_val_score(m,X_train,y_train,cv=5,scoring="f1").mean()),3) for k,m in pipes.items()}
best=max(cv_f1,key=cv_f1.get)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.pipeline import make_pipeline
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
r = pd.read_csv("reviews_text.csv")
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(r["text"], r["topic"], test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=r["topic"])


model=make_pipeline(TfidfVectorizer(),LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000)).fit(X_train,y_train)
pred=model.predict(X_test)
acc_topic=round(float((pred==y_test).mean()),3)
cm=pd.crosstab(y_test,pred)
worst_topic=min(cm.index,key=lambda k:cm.loc[k,k]/cm.loc[k].sum())
